w3_c1c2_path.json.source: constructed by bisecting canonical StochRSI rawk targets; no market data of any kind was read
w3_c1c2_path.json.why_synthetic: the PIT battery needs an exact oscillator morphology (arm below 20, trough above 2, failed micro-turn, C2a cross above 20, a flash low the sampled path never saw); a real session supplies those only by accident

w3_early_close_tape.json.source: a monotone intraday ramp on a REAL NYSE early-close session date, so the 13:00 clip is exercised against the real calendar

w3_rth_filter_tape.json.source: premarket prints at 08:00/09:15, NO print until 09:47, and postmarket prints, on a real NYSE session date
w3_rth_filter_tape.json.why_synthetic: W3-9: deleting the RTH filter survived the whole battery because every other tape prints from 09:30. An opening GAP is what makes the filter's absence visible — the 08:00 print becomes the 09:35 sampled value the moment the filter stops working
